weather_report:
Kirribilli sits under a clean, moonwashed sky at this hour, the harbour dark as ink and quietly awake. Clear conditions are set to carry through dawn, and by sunrise the day should open bright and unblinking, the light crisp and the air clear, with distant details standing out like cut glass. UV is asleep for now; after breakfast it will stir to a modest bite, even in late winter, so expect a sunny, glare-prone morning once the sun lifts.

It looks to be a pleasant, uncomplicated day: cool at first, then comfortable under a blue vault. Dress in easy layers—a warm sweater or light jacket before sunrise, something you can peel back by mid-morning—plus sunglasses, and a touch of sunscreen if you linger outdoors. Good moments today are quiet ones: a gentle foreshore walk while the city yawns awake, a takeaway coffee on a sunlit bench, a ferry across the water just for the brief shimmer of it, a short errand loop or laundry on the line to make use of the clear air, and later, a book by a bright window while the afternoon settles into itself.
